_comment: THE GRADED W6+SH ARM — 50 stations (stride-6 subset of the 300-station W6 fixture),
480 epochs = 4 h @ 30 s, DOY 2024-129, quiet.  This is the first synthetic arm ever
run in the field's wander-bearing posture with the injected satellite OSB as the
B-record truth.
ONE knob differs from _simnet300_wsh_n50: network.rank_gate_tol.  Placement follows
the BeiDou card's per-config rule, read off THIS arm's own network_estimability.csv
(runs/simnet300_wsh_n50_smoke, epoch 1):
lambda_max            9.5627e+04    -> default cutoff 9.56e-05
clock gauge depth     7.71e-12
extra near-null       1.1898e-05    (PB|*|L2W common mode, n-INVARIANT)
weakest real layer    2.8119e-02
tol 1e-12 puts the cutoff at 9.56e-08: 4.1 decades ABOVE the gauge depth (so the
clock gauge still counts as a gauge and the exact-equality assertion still holds in
the over-specified direction) and 2.1 decades BELOW the extra direction (so it
counts as real).  Never set this globally — assertNullSpaceRank throws in BOTH
directions, so a value below a healthy config's gauge depth withholds that config.
WHY NOT the alternatives, all measured (SPEC §12.2):
* more stations       -- the direction is n-INVARIANT (9.78e-06 at n=50, 8.97e-06
at n=300); 6x the stations added no information to it.
* phase_datum_eq34    -- alone: still zero epochs.
* eq34 + carry_invariant -- still zero epochs COLD, and it cannot warm through a
withhold (the carry needs emitted epochs to exist).
* sbasis_complete     -- the gate passes and the IONOSPHERE IS DESTROYED (a00
-6292 TECU at epoch 2, SH health gate withholds 18/19).
GRADE ON (pre-registered, SPEC §12.5): the B-record variance factor from
network_sat_bias_states.csv (prediction vf > 2); the exchange coefficient from
scripts/simnet_exchange.py (prediction -7.93 TECU per metre of fleet-mean rx-DCB
error, strongly anti-correlated); and the a00 level offset against the truth field's
OWN moving mean (prediction: negative and shrinking).  Settled window only -- the
level channel needs ~2 h, which is why the fixture is 4 h long.
